content.text: All stress and differential checks passed, including the 8192-class/48-round case in under a second locally. The submitted file is self-contained and about 15 KiB; I’m performing the final clean-copy and submission-artifact checks now.

arguments.command:
rm -rf /work/tmp/clean && mkdir /work/tmp/clean && cp /work/submission/main.py /work/tmp/clean/main.py
cd /work/tmp/clean && python3 -I main.py < /work/examples/diamond.json > clean.out
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, stat
p='/work/submission/main.py'
st=os.lstat(p)
assert stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode) and not stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode)
assert st.st_nlink==1, st.st_nlink
assert st.st_size<=1024*1024
x=json.load(open('/work/tmp/clean/clean.out'))
y=json.load(open('/work/examples/diamond.expected.json'))
assert x==y
print('regular file:',stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode),'links:',st.st_nlink,'bytes:',st.st_size)
print('clean-copy diamond: passed')
print('submission directory:',os.listdir('/work/submission'))
PY
# Verify the exact invalid-input status and payload from the frozen source.
set +e
printf '{"version":1,"version":1}' | python3 -I /work/submission/main.py > /work/tmp/invalid.out
status=$?
set -e
printf 'invalid status=%s payload=' "$status"; cat /work/tmp/invalid.out
test "$status" -eq 2
test "$(cat /work/tmp/invalid.out)" = '{"error":"invalid-input"}'
sha256sum /work/submission/main.py
